forswear.definition: To formally renounce or give up.
examples: He forswears alcohol for good.
She forswore violence in protest.
Monks have forsworn luxury items.
His forceful personality overbears dissent.
Evidence overbore defense arguments.
Objections were overborne completely.

smite.definition: To strike down or afflict severely.
examples: Disaster smites the prideful king.
Plague smote ancient empire city.
He was smitten with sudden illness.
Bandits waylay travelers in forest.
Reporters waylaid minister at exit.
Delegates have been waylaid.
